description: Any authenticated user can read any other user's data (no ownership check — auth_user_id is never compared to user_id)
Normal user can invoke the admin reset endpoint — no role check is performed
Accepts any field in the body including 'role', enabling mass assignment privilege escalation
No server-side cap on the 'limit' parameter — a client can request all 200 products with limit=9999
Returns internal environment info, simulated stack trace, and request headers — classic misconfiguration
Accepts an arbitrary URL and returns different responses for internal vs external URLs (SSRF pattern — simulated, does not actually fetch)
No brute-force protection or rate limiting on the login endpoint
